args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api failed health checks after deploying v2.3.1 to production (error rate 0.18, unhealthy in all regions: us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rolled back to the most recent healthy release, v2.3.0, in all production regions. Rollback verified as rolled out. Investigating root cause of v2.3.1 regression.

trace.final:
Done. Here's what I did:

1. **Checked status** — `checkout-api` was running v2.3.1 in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) and was unhealthy with an 18% error rate.

2. **Reviewed release history** — v2.2.9 and v2.3.0 were healthy in production; v2.3.1 was the latest deploy and unhealthy. The most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0**.

3. **Rolled back** — rolled `checkout-api` back to **v2.3.0** in all production regions. The rollback was verified as rolled out.

4. **Opened a SEV2 incident** — created INC-0001 for checkout-api describing the failure and the rollback; the on-call engineer was paged.

Note: the rollback to v2.3.0 is a previously healthy production version, so no change-manager approval was required.
